_readme: All values in mm. Origin = bottom-left corner of the overlay, X right, Y up, with the panel the way you see it on the desk. x/y are the CENTRE of each hole. Set verified=true once a paper print fits the real panel. See README.md.

EXAMPLE._note: Shows every feature type. Delete it or ignore it. These numbers are made up and do not match any VIRPIL panel.

CP1._measure: VPC Control Panel #1 (arriving later). Measure the plate edge, its mounting screws, and every button, switch and encoder hole.

CP2._measure: VPC Control Panel #2. Measure the plate edge, its mounting screws, the gear-lever slot and surround, every toggle and button opening, and each switch's anti-rotation key tab if it has one.

CP3._measure: VPC Control Panel #3. Measure the plate edge, its mounting screws, the B1-B13 openings, the encoder, the rotary selector and the two axis knobs (RX/RY).
